Do not return hashes; the host binds immutable hashes.", "context": {"title": "David Copperfield", "unit": 18, "heading": "CHAPTER 16. I AM A NEW BOY IN MORE SENSES THAN ONE", "previous_rows": [{"source_id": "en85-u018-b0122", "target": "Мистер Джек Мэлдон был там раньше нас. Миссис Стронг, одетая в белое, с вишнёвыми лентами, играла на фортепиано, когда мы вошли, а он, склонившись над ней, переворачивал ноты. Чистый румянец на белизне её лица был не так свеж и цветущ, как обычно, подумалось мне, когда она обернулась; но она выглядела очень хорошенькой. Удивительно хорошенькой.", "source_sha256": "3bfdb20f28d35e3a1c95c27b702930b179443c0de70472aff9efbba8275f14db", "target_id": "ru-en85-u018-b0122", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "90005b9cd4c2983f555deffb5350efb08d384643723b635a547ddcbe8985765f"}, {"source_id": "en85-u018-b0123", "target": "— Я забыла, доктор, — сказала матушка миссис Стронг, когда мы уселись, — принести вам поздравления с этим днём — хотя в моём случае, как вы можете себе представить, это далеко не просто поздравления. Позвольте пожелать вам многих и многих счастливых возвращений этого дня.", "source_sha256": "f0ffbcfe6ca6394c5675baa33b367cb370c115e90b5f3412692efac4523636e0", "target_id": "ru-en85-u018-b0123", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "575ecdc4041ab07e2674a03b09ee9996326ac1e71b70a3f0de33f22ad86336b5"}], "source_language": "English", "part": null, "book": null, "chapter": 16, "role": "chapter"}, "source_rows": [{"id": "en85-u018-b0124", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘I thank you, ma’am,’ replied the Doctor.", "sha256": "f81004cccb79f30ce55a8ae9394d6c260e43767caa1aa1f72344ff230c4f46a0", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[23]/p[124]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u018-b0125", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Many, many, many, happy returns,’ said the Old Soldier. ‘Not only for your own sake, but for Annie’s, and John Maldon’s, and many other people’s. It seems but yesterday to me, John, when you were a little creature, a head shorter than Master Copperfield, making baby love to Annie behind the gooseberry bushes in the back-garden.’", "sha256": "01f584eb1118a8d0d3b4356c4ee6df03b69e71ab914e415782dea986a9998e80", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[23]/p[125]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u018-b0126", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘My dear mama,’ said Mrs. Strong, ‘never mind that now.’", "sha256": "feaf0379b5adaec1c683fbbd80d003c3a94082960bcd2cfab7b0f360d0ecb5c6", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[23]/p[126]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u018-b0127", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Annie, don’t be absurd,’ returned her mother. ‘If you are to blush to hear of such things now you are an old married woman, when are you not to blush to hear of them?’", "sha256": "5e74190ea612f541a7b59b627942330e1215d51477c91cae3b4502162e63ee9f", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[23]/p[127]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u018-b0128", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Old?’ exclaimed Mr. Jack Maldon. ‘Annie? Come!’", "sha256": "9693bbe78e654e70122dc36a77488ac0d88ea8ddec6046143e4e18af909d0584", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[23]/p[128]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u018-b0129", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Yes, John,’ returned the Soldier. ‘Virtually, an old married woman. Although not old by years—for when did you ever hear me say, or who has ever heard me say, that a girl of twenty was old by years!—your cousin is the wife of the Doctor, and, as such, what I have described her. It is well for you, John, that your cousin is the wife of the Doctor. You have found in him an influential and kind friend, who will be kinder yet, I venture to predict, if you deserve it. I have no false pride. I never hesitate to admit, frankly, that there are some members of our family who want a friend. You were one yourself, before your cousin’s influence raised up one for you.’", "sha256": "a90a6cdd3e29c4468fc157eb5865febfe4d0e84bf6e5b15edda941a0b65253e5", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[23]/p[129]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u018-b0130", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "The Doctor, in the goodness of his heart, waved his hand as if to make light of it, and save Mr. Jack Maldon from any further reminder. But Mrs. Markleham changed her chair for one next the Doctor’s, and putting her fan on his coat-sleeve, said:", "sha256": "c899cb415634cedcc7a4f8373b8b42d8152f6bb240383095e98403cc634f9210", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[23]/p[130]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u018-b0131", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘No, really, my dear Doctor, you must excuse me if I appear to dwell on this rather, because I feel so very strongly. I call it quite my monomania, it is such a subject of mine. You are a blessing to us. You really are a Boon, you know.’", "sha256": "454ab0a25c0965cfb41ef248a470eb090a394c8bb0e74ad6930906fd8fb2d406", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[23]/p[131]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u018-b0132", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Nonsense, nonsense,’ said the Doctor.", "sha256": "d4a80937bf49dcc90d19ff75fac7ad7471db1699581bc75c7d3801c69c95e2ea", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[23]/p[132]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u018-b0133", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘No, no, I beg your pardon,’ retorted the Old Soldier. ‘With nobody present, but our dear and confidential friend Mr. Wickfield, I cannot consent to be put down. I shall begin to assert the privileges of a mother-in-law, if you go on like that, and scold you. I am perfectly honest and outspoken. What I am saying, is what I said when you first overpowered me with surprise—you remember how surprised I was?—by proposing for Annie. Not that there was anything so very much out of the way, in the mere fact of the proposal—it would be ridiculous to say that!—but because, you having known her poor father, and having known her from a baby six months old, I hadn’t thought of you in such a light at all, or indeed as a marrying man in any way,—simply that, you know.’", "sha256": "03899be0d0ef4c3362fd2b288378677ebf1babea66403637b9ceb923e34fa699", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[23]/p[133]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u018-b0134", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Aye, aye,’ returned the Doctor, good-humouredly. ‘Never mind.’", "sha256": "37a71879151a14cd6c8d3a6cc46fddb179e5219ea185607aee4bf750a752a0e9", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[23]/p[134]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u018-b0135", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘But I DO mind,’ said the Old Soldier, laying her fan upon his lips. ‘I mind very much. I recall these things that I may be contradicted if I am wrong. Well! Then I spoke to Annie, and I told her what had happened. I said, “My dear, here’s Doctor Strong has positively been and made you the subject of a handsome declaration and an offer.” Did I press it in the least? No. I said, “Now, Annie, tell me the truth this moment; is your heart free?” “Mama,” she said crying, “I am extremely young”—which was perfectly true—“and I hardly know if I have a heart at all.” “Then, my dear,” I said, “you may rely upon it, it’s free. At all events, my love,” said I, “Doctor Strong is in an agitated state of mind, and must be answered. He cannot be kept in his present state of suspense.” “Mama,” said Annie, still crying, “would he be unhappy without me? If he would, I honour and respect him so much, that I think I will have him.” So it was settled. And then, and not till then, I said to Annie, “Annie, Doctor Strong will not only be your husband, but he will represent your late father: he will represent the head of our family, he will represent the wisdom and station, and I may say the means, of our family; and will be, in short, a Boon to it.” I used the word at the time, and I have used it again, today. If I have any merit it is consistency.’", "sha256": "dec2c9526cdf2d9af220ac63032bc6fe0e5276e580cd3dc7f5e7fc755e224f74", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[23]/p[135]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u018-b0136", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "The daughter had sat quite silent and still during this speech, with her eyes fixed on the ground; her cousin standing near her, and looking on the ground too. She now said very softly, in a trembling voice:", "sha256": "1a082d26197ce694837aa3784e3a994eb3dc038a28d9637db6a9ff32844f4144", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[23]/p[136]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u018-b0137", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Mama, I hope you have finished?’ ‘No, my dear Annie,’ returned the Old Soldier, ‘I have not quite finished. Since you ask me, my love, I reply that I have not. I complain that you really are a little unnatural towards your own family; and, as it is of no use complaining to you. I mean to complain to your husband. Now, my dear Doctor, do look at that silly wife of yours.’", "sha256": "1cb814fb141d22caaffa47fc21c0f911d578b942800616d1506de0ade63d1aef", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[23]/p[137]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u018-b0138", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "As the Doctor turned his kind face, with its smile of simplicity and gentleness, towards her, she drooped her head more. I noticed that Mr. Wickfield looked at her steadily.", "sha256": "5a47a3ba9546ff62187646d17b989e4b442a7f0b97316fe301671bcb63786b51", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[23]/p[138]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u018-b0139", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘When I happened to say to that naughty thing, the other day,’ pursued her mother, shaking her head and her fan at her, playfully, ‘that there was a family circumstance she might mention to you—indeed, I think, was bound to mention—she said, that to mention it was to ask a favour; and that, as you were too generous, and as for her to ask was always to have, she wouldn’t.’", "sha256": "63edec2d144e3237e3b13b34c9eb31a3d6df508855adb4fef4728b38e72077f6", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[23]/p[139]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u018-b0140", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Annie, my dear,’ said the Doctor. ‘That was wrong. It robbed me of a pleasure.’", "sha256": "376ea16588b7af138f11aa05bbe18a8d2ee029db1e652519718d65c194d8e3f9", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[23]/p[140]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u018-b0141", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Almost the very words I said to her!’ exclaimed her mother. ‘Now really, another time, when I know what she would tell you but for this reason, and won’t, I have a great mind, my dear Doctor, to tell you myself.’", "sha256": "1dd7ecb8e6fdcc595ac515fd1269a780063be2d93b682ab4e69c924ef2614b23", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[23]/p[141]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u018-b0142", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘I shall be glad if you will,’ returned the Doctor.", "sha256": "bbf0cc36f32ca393cbcff7bc5f55ff62740efb8f183bb0d77a1a4116d0a3e6fd", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[23]/p[142]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u018-b0143", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Shall I?’", "sha256": "5be7585dec4dea7dc1c92d238e03e321d5861b881f04b7753fd85639ca46f3ca", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[23]/p[143]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u018-b0144", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Certainly.’", "sha256": "b343cfdb893b630d807f18d305ebf66771f4f6c53cd9b45f288a26d81c2974e2", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[23]/p[144]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u018-b0145", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Well, then, I will!’ said the Old Soldier. ‘That’s a bargain.’ And having, I suppose, carried her point, she tapped the Doctor’s hand several times with her fan (which she kissed first), and returned triumphantly to her former station.", "sha256": "92673035f752d503280def1040bbfff62db784f378602bd5a49c70baa9bd3561", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[23]/p[145]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u018-b0146", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "Some more company coming in, among whom were the two masters and Adams, the talk became general; and it naturally turned on Mr. Jack Maldon, and his voyage, and the country he was going to, and his various plans and prospects. He was to leave that night, after supper, in a post-chaise, for Gravesend; where the ship, in which he was to make the voyage, lay; and was to be gone—unless he came home on leave, or for his health—I don’t know how many years. I recollect it was settled by general consent that India was quite a misrepresented country, and had nothing objectionable in it, but a tiger or two, and a little heat in the warm part of the day. For my own part, I looked on Mr. Jack Maldon as a modern Sindbad, and pictured him the bosom friend of all the Rajahs in the East, sitting under canopies, smoking curly golden pipes—a mile long, if they could be straightened out.", "sha256": "097a9850ddb2cdeb2af3b89f51eacff53d50c74346baa43ac4c7c4d481a23e83", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[23]/p[146]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u018-b0147", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "Mrs. Strong was a very pretty singer: as I knew, who often heard her singing by herself. But, whether she was afraid of singing before people, or was out of voice that evening, it was certain that she couldn’t sing at all. She tried a duet, once, with her cousin Maldon, but could not so much as begin; and afterwards, when she tried to sing by herself, although she began sweetly, her voice died away on a sudden, and left her quite distressed, with her head hanging down over the keys. The good Doctor said she was nervous, and, to relieve her, proposed a round game at cards; of which he knew as much as of the art of playing the trombone. But I remarked that the Old Soldier took him into custody directly, for her partner; and instructed him, as the first preliminary of initiation, to give her all the silver he had in his pocket.", "sha256": "db06401fe7c16f91efe1927ed0ef0d6d4662ecef1df1ea48789a97da31f37d3d", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[23]/p[147]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u018-b0148", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "We had a merry game, not made the less merry by the Doctor’s mistakes, of which he committed an innumerable quantity, in spite of the watchfulness of the butterflies, and to their great aggravation. Mrs. Strong had declined to play, on the ground of not feeling very well; and her cousin Maldon had excused himself because he had some packing to do. When he had done it, however, he returned, and they sat together, talking, on the sofa. From time to time she came and looked over the Doctor’s hand, and told him what to play. She was very pale, as she bent over him, and I thought her finger trembled as she pointed out the cards; but the Doctor was quite happy in her attention, and took no notice of this, if it were so.", "sha256": "1a9ed4952b5fc2e706a5978a40e5126b823b27453a153397b8cfba321bb78286", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[23]/p[148]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u018-b0149", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "At supper, we were hardly so gay. Everyone appeared to feel that a parting of that sort was an awkward thing, and that the nearer it approached, the more awkward it was. Mr. Jack Maldon tried to be very talkative, but was not at his ease, and made matters worse. And they were not improved, as it appeared to me, by the Old Soldier: who continually recalled passages of Mr. Jack Maldon’s youth.", "sha256": "15866a310baf3168f913e7432379a172612c743279bc4adc4c9642047ddc51f9", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[23]/p[149]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u018-b0150", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "The Doctor, however, who felt, I am sure, that he was making everybody happy, was well pleased, and had no suspicion but that we were all at the utmost height of enjoyment.", "sha256": "4aa718592553bf3bd0387c1e0fd6dd0c2b404eafe8dd0b7bdae0b49e03743081", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[23]/p[150]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u018-b0151", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Annie, my dear,’ said he, looking at his watch, and filling his glass, ‘it is past your cousin Jack’s time, and we must not detain him, since time and tide—both concerned in this case—wait for no man. Mr. Jack Maldon, you have a long voyage, and a strange country, before you; but many men have had both, and many men will have both, to the end of time. The winds you are going to tempt, have wafted thousands upon thousands to fortune, and brought thousands upon thousands happily back.’", "sha256": "91e1d5648dcefc7efaa37e8c6f00292d719cd77c0c69ed6842878e633bcb5d09", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[23]/p[151]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u018-b0152", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘It’s an affecting thing,’ said Mrs. Markleham—‘however it’s viewed, it’s affecting, to see a fine young man one has known from an infant, going away to the other end of the world, leaving all he knows behind, and not knowing what’s before him. A young man really well deserves constant support and patronage,’ looking at the Doctor, ‘who makes such sacrifices.’", "sha256": "68d0b0511d3ceada62e8ae9470a417d4ca247b664282e5d8e8c566bfc0871e3c", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[23]/p[152]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u018-b0153", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Time will go fast with you, Mr. Jack Maldon,’ pursued the Doctor, ‘and fast with all of us. Some of us can hardly expect, perhaps, in the natural course of things, to greet you on your return. The next best thing is to hope to do it, and that’s my case. I shall not weary you with good advice. You have long had a good model before you, in your cousin Annie.
